notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h3]

[h2]We are excited to announce that our game is a part of [b]Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻[/b][/h2] 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek

This special event is organized to celebrate [b]World Animal Day[/b] and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During [b]Animal Week[/b], our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

[h3]Here, we’ll show you a few examples of how you can take care of animals in Espresso Tycoon. [/h3]

Our mission in Sydney focuses on this the most. It takes place in an underwater café (interestingly, this is also the setting for our Prologue, which was chosen by you – our community ːsteamhappyː ).


There, you can encounter various animals swimming around the café and get to know their stories. 
These stories often highlight the problems these animals face due to ocean pollution. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/289f0d48539009cd844081b6cfea40a92e487d97.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d69117423350710cc835749bc54b1db5bf9f072d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/27ac23a806b38b26c47d30ed1ab2c13c8ff6cd44.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/dc23f790ba37aca8c3352eb68738772eef571482.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3fd7ab237bea563d27fdc9f777b86fc09a3e621b.png[/img]

What's more - when you click on a dog or cat, they do different tricks ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3b752befc3345563f6ab225d9af69632a76c0a5a.gif[/img]

The [b]main partner of Animal Week[/b] is [b]WWF Poland[/b], a leading conservation organization, that brings their [b]extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability.[/b] Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - New Features Are Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

A huge thank you for your votes in our poll on what we should develop further in our game! We are also impressed by your ideas 😀 As always, you've been incredibly helpful, and thanks to you, we've created a [b]roadmap[/b] - and we already know what else will be coming to[b] Espresso Tycoon[/b]!

[h3]Check it out![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/9148a4413959bef80c80805d696570f6921a684b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Café on the Moon[/b] - we gave you a choice between the Moon and Mars - we can see that most of you decided on the Moon 🌕
[*] [b]Manager[/b] - who will take care of Supplies - and allow you to automate the process of ordering and collecting them 📋
[*] [b]Import 3D Models[/b] - exchange via [b]Steam Workshop[/b] ✅
[*] [b]2 Coffee Machines[/b] - which will allow even faster coffee-making and customer service ☕️
[*] [b]Alternative Campaigns in the same locations[/b] - that is, new missions with new challenges in places you already know very well 🌎
[/list]
And here are some answers to questions you may still have.

[h3]When will these new features will be added to the game?[/h3]

We are not giving specific dates because we need to be sure that each of these new features is done well and will not generate bugs. That takes time and a lot of testing. We'll let you know as soon as we're ready!

[h3]I voted for several other features, but they are not on the list. Does that mean they won't appear at all?
[/h3]
We're presenting on the roadmap the features that were most frequently requested by our players. We still have a few things more in our plan (as you can see our game is regularly updated) and we will inform you about them, for sure! These ones are the most significant changes that are going to be added in the near future.

[h3]I've tested your latest updates. Will there be such a possibility here as well?
[/h3]

Of course! We appreciate very much that you help us create our game and assist us with testing. We will certainly organize tests of new features as soon as we are ready.

[h3]Will these new features be for free?[/h3]
Yes, all those features we list here will be added free of charge to the basic version of [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b].

Once again - thank you so much for helping us choose the features and create the roadmap together!

Which is your favorite one? ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=wvmm1ulapy8;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, you can create a variety of different (and delicious!) recipes.

To make a coffee with toppings like that, we need to do various things, some of which can be complicated.

As you can see, it's an important location for us, and we have a lot of sentimental attachment to it.

Just showing old materials brings a tear to our eye because that's where our work on [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b] began! It's a piece of history!

Have you ever traveled for a very long time by [b]train[/b]? Imagine spending so many hours without coffee... Yes, we know, it's hard to imagine. That's why we thought a [b]coffee shop on the train [/b]can be a great idea! There may be little competition, but we might get demanding customers. That's a challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/623099f04827685f688e489b8b71dac765b7d041.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/5ff8e8b98d10fd94a4843fad8e8a7be94debeae4.png[/img]

We started by [b]building a train[/b], and the cafe is located in one of the train cars - that's our base. But we also had to take care of the chassis, tracks, and other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/7a318563926cc9d2208ca017e12b4445a30ebc75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/1f9e0b21d3650d4c30b3bfeea9d0614a8df7239c.png[/img]

And of course, the [b]locomotive[/b] must not be missing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/080ebc6824aa1b606a9d173153dae408d62e6fc4.png[/img]

[b]Why did we choose Siberia?[/b] Because it is the geographic region that we associate with very long train journeys (you know, the [b]Trans-Siberian Railway[/b]). But you will probably notice that the atmosphere from the [b]Orient Express[/b] can also be found here, mainly in the decorative elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ee8e4aa1d13cbe4891f6af4c4cf80ae0a4622ae0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/f4bd0b6133ac68daca4ce8441b84a4dedd52a2d7.png[/img]

We also solved the problem of supplying resources to our train. It's quite a relief that, as a rule, our [b]supplies are delivered by drones[/b] ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/8f704c7930dda9b8f05be4ebc4ecd8abc67a8014.gif[/img]

And this is crucial because, without coal, our train will not go any further.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b5093759006462947172032962aa648e87fee48f.gif[/img]

Running a cafe on the train is our fifth mission, and we are introducing some new features to it.

Among them is [b]Research[/b], which will allow you to unlock new ingredients and decoration items (after setting the right budget and category).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3eeb014861693e8e1e873344cf45aebaa2112a57.png[/img]

We are also explaining more elements related to the [b]Coffee Editor[/b]. One very important one is [b]Temporal Trends[/b]. As you probably already know, each social group in our game has its own preferences. If we manage to meet all the requirements, including [b]Temporal Trends[/b], not only will we be sure that our customers will love a particular recipe, but they will also [b]tip us[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/45b023cfa420ea8a1fca23ad339987cd297c6e8a.png[/img]

But it's important to note that [b]Temporal Trends[/b], as the name suggests, are temporal, so they will change. You need to keep track of them to stay up to date.

BTW, have you ever dreamed of having a train named after yourself? Now you can have it ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b33191dbfa022e496cddad77151f121b005d6e52.png[/img]

[h3]Do you like our cafe on the train? Let us know what you think![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c7fd4a18906c54f205db408955c19d24e4d7bc6f.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW LOCATION in Espresso Tycoon - Paris
notes.content:
Bonjour Coffee Lovers!

It's time to present our next location in [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b]...

[h3]PARIS!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/a5b7e3552e80cc0dbebed2d6d82f1976541e9526.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce the opening of a new location for our coffee shop [b]in the heart of Paris[/b]! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring the best coffee experience to our customers, and we are excited to share our newest addition with you.

Some of you probably expected the [b]French café[/b] to be one of our next locations. We proposed it to you in the voting for the location of our [b]Prologue[/b] (the underwater café in Sydney won then, but Paris also got a lot of votes).

So we got down to work!

We knew that we would have to pay a lot of attention to the architecture of the entire neighborhood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c0bcd59fd0a6be43fcd395e15a6a9b18c3fa76f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0d9c06d2975c3feae7467bea6646561ca265f8e0.png[/img]

The new location is situated on a [b]charming Parisian street[/b]. The buildings represent a beautiful architectural style, with large windows that let in plenty of natural light. The interior has been designed to create a [b]cozy atmosphere[/b], with comfortable seating and a warm color scheme that will make you feel right at home. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/78676f875eea26d6b3b2cc930d29e77eeb24d315.png[/img]

Because these are the things that come to our minds when we think about the French café:
[list]
[*] great atmosphere
[*] a lot of interesting people
[*] unique design
[*] beautiful buildings
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ddd449082dfc560165be6f71bc0cb552cbc851ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d7afa8cf325fc39ef06fdd9cbc04f67315126831.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c738eb4ad7bc0fe27cd2ac1df9591efee39b310b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b48e77f7c88b4b5580ee47562de48712c7f57226.png[/img]

We also took care of the details; you will find a lot of decorative elements that will be associated with the French style. You can also see the [b]famous tower[/b]... ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b1b731b325513034b5a45d0ab239585f5018b16f.png[/img]

In this mission, we're introducing... [b]snacks[/b] (it's a must-have in a French café, right?). Those who have already played our demo or Prologue will surely be pleased with the new feature - that is, the automatic refilling of snacks. Quite a few players have been asking for it, so we couldn't be indifferent to it ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/865fde6429ccbffd4dc87ee778c48bc5a8ac6111.png[/img]

This mission will also teach you how to influence the speed of baristas with the right coffee machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3c94a09e78b9999a6c7ca0c806add04334d281f3.png[/img]

As you know, running a successful coffee shop takes hard work and dedication, and we are grateful for your support in making our business a success. We hope that you will visit our new location soon and enjoy the coffee and atmosphere that we have created.

[h3]Thank you for being a part of the Espresso Tycoon community, and we look forward to serving you in Paris![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/cb1e16c9d142c57df44b4709f30f389027063fd6.png[/img]

Au revoir!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543280/Espresso_Tycoon/

notes.title: Ordering supplies - Have you seen the DRONE?
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

You must keep track of the stock you have in your coffee shop. Order coffee beans, milk, and syrups, and choose their quality and price. 

Click on the supplies icon in the upper right corner to open the supplies window.
[h3][b]
Choosing the products[/b][/h3]
Choose the bookmark with the product category you need to order. Check their quality, unit capacity, and price.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d1d6983abd0645d9804061231707f4ae042c0f7c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Ordering supplies[/b][/h3]
Click the "Order" button to see the order details. Choose the number of units and the time of delivery. Note that an instant delivery is quick but expensive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ef3ad409aa111fd4f93079a25e9aca8936e69746.png[/img]

[h3][b]Refilling the supplies[/b][/h3]
You will get notified if your supplies run out of stock. Click on the notification to open the supplies window and order new ones. Try to avoid missing supplies not to get negative reviews.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/9eca478354c5531d2194edeaefb208f26904c960.png[/img]

[h3][b]Checking needed supplies[/b][/h3]
Open the menu window and move the cursor to a coffee recipe to check what supplies you need. You’ll also see other requirements for preparing a given coffee.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c68ea1b5fc88b6605cd7369be0ebaacc10eeee1e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Changing the priorities[/b][/h3]
If you have more than one ingredient in the same group (and they differ in quality) you can change the priorities of using them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/e9356500d0d7d90cadf18de968a5b9ee32f7c6cd.png[/img]

[h3][b]Receiving the order[/b][/h3]
Your supplies will arrive at your coffee shop by drone delivery. You will see them arriving with the package containing your order.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0ecaa73c48853879914cbbbb8e795ca9e9539440.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Collecting the supplies[/b][/h3]
Click on the packages to collect them. Once you do it they will get added to your supplies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/e5bd6bf742cea8fce7c47a1706c7c422b5afd75e.png[/img]

Don't forget to check the budget! Think a few steps ahead and organize your supplies' delivery wisely ːsteamhappyː

[h3]You can check this feature in our demo:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543280/Espresso_Tycoon/

And in our Prologue soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904980/Espresso_Tycoon_Prologue_Underwater/

notes.title: You will not believe WHAT SHE DID in that coffee shop!
notes.content:
[h3]A famous businesswoman lost a billion dollars after visiting[b] ‘Sleepless Nights’ [/b]- the most popular coffee shop in the city![/h3]

[b]Rachel Nelson (36) [/b]- as usual - was in a hurry. Being her thoughts at the upcoming business meeting, without unnecessary thought, she ordered coffee advertised on the stand - [b]Special Coffee to go.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/02698dacabfcbd99e9bc17cb4dab47fb62678f86.png[/img]

There would be nothing extraordinary about it, if not for the fact that the Special Coffee she got was - indeed - special ... The coffee consisted of [b]MAYONAISSE, TABASCO[/b], and [b]FISH SAUCE[/b]. 
[h3]HOW SO, you may ask? Read below![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/69f39f5a30d43563fbddc25b97868cddf2d26597.gif[/img]

It happened by an accident. 'Sleepless Nights’ adds a new coffee recipe to the menu each month. [b]Mark Smith (32)[/b], an experienced barista, was responsible for adding[b] Special Coffee in Jul[/b]y.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/cb346fd1ff816e82409454bbb16c8dd58ec42f12.gif[/img]

‘I was supposed to add strawberry sauce, cinnamon sauce, and heavy cream. I didn’t notice that my little son, [b]Steve (5)[/b], waiting for me to finish my job, changed the labels of the ingredients! - [b]said Mark[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4c04c0f6e919a3b0d199bf03f6a02e0221a94845.gif[/img]

‘When preparing that unfortunate coffee I was very tired... it was my last order that day’ - [b]Mark added[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c7a95f051e4d0092f61f5534f666ecf54983af86.gif[/img]

Do you remember the businesswoman from the first picture? 
Rachel was a regular customer of ‘Sleepless Nights’ so she didn’t expect anything out of ordinary. She decided to order [b]Special Coffee[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b1612ed3c1bf8796fc83e5c3e06804efcd0bb37c.gif[/img]

The most shocking fact about this whole situation is that Rachel actually ENJOYED her coffee! She even gave a positive review!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/f834dbe1538c8806302aeb499f09bd52978abd22.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, after drinking the new recipe she got stuck in the toilet for a good while. As we know from an anonymous friend of Rachel, due to that, she missed her business meeting and the deal wasn't concluded. That was a[b] billion-dollar[/b] loss for Rachel Nelson!

To make up for this mistake, the coffee shop gave her a lifetime discount.
"I regret nothing" -[b] said Rachel[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/378081ba761971b20a6a337c27429707942df8f1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Which toppings would YOU add?
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

We know that our [b]3D coffee editor[/b] really caught your attention at the Next Fest on Steam. But it wasn’t our last word! We’re still improving that feature.

You may have noticed the ‘Coming soon’ button at the top of the UI in the Coffee Editor. Now it's the time to reveal what's hidden behind it.

[h3]The toppings are coming![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c1d7d66161db02cd9ec6e10051130c4f43cb896a.jpg[/img]

To make a coffee with toppings like that we need to do a lot of different (and sometimes complicated, too).

You know, whipped cream is a must here. We’ve started from this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/8ef9c71fd07eb96a51efdc013be80a6109fa8559.gif[/img]
 
To finish with that:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/45816d01e9ca6624f981c93d73f91fdcd528a3ef.png[/img] 

As you can see, we're adding a few versions of what the whipped cream could look like in the new coffee recipe. We have to work not only on the texture and the visual of each new topping but also on its combination with other ingredients. 

[h3]Fruits, sprinkles, and more![/h3]

We're adding also some fruits (like blueberry or cherry). You will be able to put them on the coffee you’re creating, in the order you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/219b68d112e88904d5a4af60741c27b59f5f43fc.gif[/img]
 
Of course, whipped cream and fruits are just the beginning of the whole ‘toppings’ category. 
We’re going to add also:
[list]
[*] wafers
[*] cocoa
[*] sprinkles
[*] chocolate
[*] and much more.
[/list]
That will help you create the most delicious coffee recipe!

And it’s just the first level of our work with toppings. We have to merge them with the mechanics that we already have in our Espresso Tycoon. Each topping will influence the number of calories, capacity, temperature, etc. And – what’s more important – it will change the market research. You will see which social groups will love that new recipe (even the craziest one) and which ones will never buy it.

notes.title: Devlog #4 – new updates
notes.content:
Let us present you some new features that we’ve been working on in [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b].

[h2]1. City life nearby the coffee shop[/h2]

The coffee shop is not the only place where something’s going on in [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b]. There will be also some people in the streets (and not everyone will come to your place – you have to convince customers to come). But there will be also [b]city traffic[/b] with some cars driving (or staying, when the red light is on).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/05f08d38e0053978199fa988e15ea24450402334.gif[/img]

We added also [b]birds[/b] – pigeons, to be more specific. They will fly in different directions nearby the coffee shop, they can also sit on the roof.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0a35baad160ac1a5d38d31c125c33e11cf516526.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Different movements and behaviors[/h2]

Our customers will not just stand or sit still in one pose. That would look odd. That’s why we decided to implement some [b]different gestures and movement[/b]s. They will move their legs, hands, they can stretch a bit, wave, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6af870c7b3fa894c635baa49fffdddb1b2909426.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Emotions of the characters[/h2]

We focus a lot on the[b] facial expressions[/b] of the characters. We are adding different emotions to them. That’s why you can see if they are happy, sad, or angry. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/01897811e1ba6292fcf1e386a5693491de207286.gif[/img]

[h2]4. Adding a mess to the coffee shop[/h2]

A player will have to remember to [b]clean the coffee shop[/b]. The customers can leave the garbage – like dirty cups or used napkins. It will be also a feature connected with managing the employees. If a player will not be able to keep the place clean – the customers will not be happy. That’s why there will be a need to [b]hire a cleaner[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/8cef98a88ae09d10111ec6f7cfbc1a62eecdd181.gif[/img]

[h2]5. New decoration items[/h2]
We're still adding new items to the decoration feature, so you will be able to create [b]the coffee shop[/b] out of your dreams. We already have a lot of different floors, colors, and textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ec7b858058ddfbee4833bc8d4db91b103205bae4.gif[/img]

That’s all for that devlog episode – we will keep you informed about our next steps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/a59fc59ce09d9a6cc1e94a239d7cac431b21b1a9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 – New features
notes.content:
There are a lot of new features which are added to our game [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b]. We are still testing and checking them – but we already can see that many details can really change the look of the character and the game is becoming more and more interesting.

[h2]Blink and look[/h2]

We added [b]blinking[/b] to our characters and they can [b]look in a few different directions[/b]. You may say that it’s not that noticeable but just think about a queue with people looking in the same direction, without an eye movement. That would look odd. And we want our game to be as realistic as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/e7ad6a5bf4cfb4cef81296849704e5c75f54d724.gif[/img]

[h2]Decorate your coffee shop[/h2]

[b]The decoration[/b] is one of those elements that many players are waiting for - they want to create the coffee shop out of their dreams. That’s why we pay attention to many details. We are adding a lot of items (and a lot of new ones are going to be added). You can set them at different angles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/27c77c89072f8170c28bf0f7cfae30c3a5081b25.gif[/img]

[h2]Check your budget[/h2]

If you buy too many items – you will run out of money and your [b]business[/b] will fail. We added the notification about the [b]bankruptcy[/b] getting closer, and - if you don’t control it - you will say goodbye to your coffee shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3850e0b6bd339aa4c419ae656717946c181b6cdb.gif[/img]

[h2]Speed up the game [/h2]

You can also [b]speed up[/b] the game if you want. That’s the feature that is added to a lot of tycoon games. Now it’s also in [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/946c7cfbba5649851d0eafaa9877853a2015e03d.gif[/img]

We will inform you about the next steps. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Dev log #2 - Differences between people
notes.content:
We are still focused on preparing the demo version of [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b]. That’s why we have started some next steps to develop it.
We want our game to be as realistic as possible. That’s why we need to focus on a lot of different details. One of them is implementing the diversity between customers. 

[h2]Different customers in Espresso Tycoon
[/h2]
Creating the characters in the game includes taking into consideration a lot of factors – like ethnicity, age, or sex. The characters will also differ in style and colors of clothes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/a0b0fdf924901b6ae08d5b7208d485fa0ffc9913.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/1ce94f3ea807d20437f86a938c1557658509c596.jpg[/img]


In [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b] we are going to have eight different social groups:
[list]
[*] Kids
[*] Seniors
[*] Tourists
[*] Business
[*] Hipsters
[*] Casuals
[*] Students
[*] Tech
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/412b920f5aca1a4f613c3f664878356f5dba9a3a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/bcc6c747dbacc18a1cc8ada1d36e3cb968cbd2e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Do the market research[/h2]

One may think that running a coffee shop means just realizing the orders and selling coffee. Well, that’s a big mistake. The diversity between people means also different customers’ preferences. It is influenced by many factors – like the place, the decoration, prices of your coffee, but also kinds of coffee, even the beans that are used to create the recipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/420996cf00c7e9e4173e27969ddf46b947cfba8a.png[/img]

The player will need to think about which kind of coffee should be on the menu – for example, seniors prefer some traditional recipes, like just black coffee. On the other hand – you can’t sell caffeine or alcohol to the kids (and you have to remember about it!), but they would love to buy some sweets or hot chocolate. Hipster can order a coffee with some special ingredients - like almond milk. That’s why you have to remember about ordering all the supplies you need.

[h2]Other people in the Espresso Tycoon[/h2]

In [b]Espresso Tycoon [/b]there will be some more characters, which will have some special functions in the game – like your employees (baristas or cleaners) and influencers, who can be invited to your coffee shop to promote your place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/05365c931a5bb0aced06619d2736f12c1dd01e6c.png[/img]

We thought also about the bodyguards, who can protect the coffee shop - if you would like to sabotage your rivals (and they would like to revenge). But maybe that’s too much? 

Tell us, what you think.

notes.title: Dive into a hardcore management system
notes.content:
[h2]What challenges await you in Espresso Tycoon?[/h2]

If you think running a coffee shop is a piece of cake, you are wrong. At least in the Espresso Tycoon game! Here, your decision-making comes from both small things, such as the pet rules for your coffee shop, and very large ones, such as opening hours. If you want to build a successful coffee business you will have to deal with all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/bd576f2b555015651f98a78103a4a83decef00c3.png[/img]

[h2]Let's start from the beginning[/h2]

Every businessman should set himself milestones towards which he strives. Espresso Tycoon is full of such milestones. For example - before you can start selling coffee and getting rich, you need to, obviously, get your café ready. What other tasks await you?

[list]
[*] choosing a location for your first and each subsequent coffee shop
[*] decorating and furnishing your premises
[*] hiring, training, and taking care of the needs of different types of employees
[*] creating your own logo using the brand editor
[*] setting menus, prices and brewing your own coffee
[*] setting opening hours and policies, which may be different for each of your cafés
[*] taking care of the supply chain and ordering coffee grounds from all over the world
[*] analyzing customer opinions, advertising, and cooperating with popular influencers
[*] taking on challenges and missions that will help you earn some extra cash and fame
[*] expansion of your own coffee empire
[/list]

Sounds like a challenge, right? Don't worry - no one is born a perfect businessman. Explore the world of Espresso Tycoon step by step. Learn, observe, and make bold decisions to soon become a successful coffee shop owner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/cbed912b0bddfd7afa119394664de59969ae0d3e.png[/img]

[h2]Plan, decide, analyze and act![/h2]

Remember that every decision you make affects the world around your coffee shop. Your clients will be happy to share their opinion on social media, especially on the Beanstagram platform. Learn to listen to them! 

In addition, numerous tools come to your aid, such as graphs summarizing your activities so far. However, let's face it - your observations and plans are the most important here. See for yourself how rich the Espresso Tycoon world is and how deep the management system it offers. Do you think you can handle it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4ac0d6bb52ac4babd020317e6ca3935a2c58f316.gif[/img]
